presentation.headline: Relay dependency network
presentation.lede: One dated gap, one blocked environment boundary, and two readiness handoffs whose dates remain unknown. The graph shows where evidence must cross teams without turning gaps into CPM claims.
presentation.insight_heading: The dated problem is narrow; the evidence problem is broader.
insight_points: DEP-AUDIT has a two-calendar-day local gap, but the remaining schedule is not present.
DEP-ENV needs a provider, usable boundary and dates before it can be managed as an interface agreement.
Security and service-readiness arrows remain unconfirmed rather than borrowing later outcomes.
presentation.decision: Reconcile DEP-AUDIT timing and acceptance with both sides, then assign and date the environment boundary.

analysis.method: Rule-based coordination view using supplied status and comparable needed-by/forecast dates. Local calendar margin is not CPM float or proven project delay.

notes: All records are fictional training data.
Proposed boundary records preserve unknown dates and authority instead of inventing them.
